attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Oklahoma state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per OK tax code (2025). Skeleton table: filing-status conditions are populated as real EL but tax-calculation actions are intentionally empty pending authorship — postfix is empty and the 6-bracket progressive walk plus personal exemption credit logic is not yet wired through. Constants live in OK_edd.xml (ok_bracket_*, ok_standard_deduction_*, ok_personal_exemption_credit). See issue #446.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.ok_limit_1 = ok_bracket_1_limit; set result.ok_limit_2 = ok_bracket_2_limit; set result.ok_limit_3 = ok_bracket_3_limit; set result.ok_limit_4 = ok_bracket_4_limit; set result.ok_limit_5 = ok_bracket_5_limit; set result.ok_high_base = ok_single_high_base; set result.ok_std_deduction = ok_standard_deduction_single; set result.ok_senior_limit = ok_senior_limit_single
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: ok_bracket_1_limit cvd /result.ok_limit_1 xdef ok_bracket_2_limit cvd /result.ok_limit_2 xdef ok_bracket_3_limit cvd /result.ok_limit_3 xdef ok_bracket_4_limit cvd /result.ok_limit_4 xdef ok_bracket_5_limit cvd /result.ok_limit_5 xdef ok_single_high_base cvd /result.ok_high_base xdef ok_standard_deduction_single cvd /result.ok_std_deduction xdef ok_senior_limit_single cvd /result.ok_senior_limit xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Married Filing Joint or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Head of Household: joint table column, its own standard deduction
Married Filing Separate: single table column

action_details.action_comment: Married filing joint or head of household table column
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ok_limit_1 = ok_joint_bracket_1_limit; set result.ok_limit_2 = ok_joint_bracket_2_limit; set result.ok_limit_3 = ok_joint_bracket_3_limit; set result.ok_limit_4 = ok_joint_bracket_4_limit; set result.ok_limit_5 = ok_joint_bracket_5_limit; set result.ok_high_base = ok_joint_high_base
action_details.action_postfix: ok_joint_bracket_1_limit cvd /result.ok_limit_1 xdef ok_joint_bracket_2_limit cvd /result.ok_limit_2 xdef ok_joint_bracket_3_limit cvd /result.ok_limit_3 xdef ok_joint_bracket_4_limit cvd /result.ok_limit_4 xdef ok_joint_bracket_5_limit cvd /result.ok_limit_5 xdef ok_joint_high_base cvd /result.ok_high_base xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ok_std_deduction = ok_standard_deduction_joint; set result.ok_senior_limit = ok_senior_limit_joint
action_details.action_postfix: ok_standard_deduction_joint cvd /result.ok_std_deduction xdef ok_senior_limit_joint cvd /result.ok_senior_limit xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ok_std_deduction = ok_standard_deduction_hoh; set result.ok_senior_limit = ok_senior_limit_hoh
action_details.action_postfix: ok_standard_deduction_hoh cvd /result.ok_std_deduction xdef ok_senior_limit_hoh cvd /result.ok_senior_limit xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ok_std_deduction = ok_standard_deduction_mfs; set result.ok_senior_limit = ok_senior_limit_mfs
action_details.action_postfix: ok_standard_deduction_mfs cvd /result.ok_std_deduction xdef ok_senior_limit_mfs cvd /result.ok_senior_limit xdef

action_details.action_comment: Line 11 exemptions, with the special 65+ exemption under the AGI limit
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ok_exemptions = length of job.taxpayers + length of job.dependents; if result.state_calc_agi <= result.ok_senior_limit then { set result.ok_exemptions = result.ok_exemptions + result.senior_std_count; } endif
action_details.action_postfix: job.taxpayers length job.dependents length + cvd /result.ok_exemptions xdef { result.ok_exemptions result.senior_std_count f+ cvd /result.ok_exemptions xdef } {} result.state_calc_agi result.ok_senior_limit f<= ifelse

action_details.action_comment: Line 13 taxable income; line 14 tax from the table
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ok_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.ok_std_deduction - result.ok_exemptions * ok_personal_exemption_credit) and 0.0; perform OK_Tax_Table; set result.ok_tax = result.ok_table_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.ok_std_deduction f- result.ok_exemptions ok_personal_exemption_credit fmul f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ok_taxable_income xdef /OK_Tax_Table performtable result.ok_table_tax cvd /result.ok_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Harvested onto the roster by Compute_Roster_State_Tax
action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.ok_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.ok_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.ok_taxable_income cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.ok_tax cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: add " Oklahoma (Form 511 2025): taxable income $" + result.ok_taxable_income + " (standard deduction $" + result.ok_std_deduction + ", " + result.ok_exemptions + " exemptions), tax $" + result.ok_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: " Oklahoma (Form 511 2025): taxable income $" result.ok_taxable_income strconcat " (standard deduction $" strconcat result.ok_std_deduction strconcat ", " strconcat result.ok_exemptions strconcat " exemptions), tax $" strconcat result.ok_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Oklahoma military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption for all military retirement income (Group B). MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt. Skeleton table: only the no-pay zero-assignment action is populated as real EL; conditions and remaining actions intentionally empty pending authorship. See issue #446.

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion

initial_action.initial_action_postfix: result.ok_taxable_income 50.0 fdiv floor 50.0 fmul 25.0 f+ cvd /result.ok_band_midpoint xdef

action_details.action_comment: Bracket tax at the band midpoint, rounded
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ok_table_tax = the floor of (ok_bracket_1_rate * (the minimum of result.ok_band_midpoint and result.ok_limit_1) + ok_bracket_2_rate * (the maximum of ((the minimum of result.ok_band_midpoint and result.ok_limit_2) - result.ok_limit_1) and 0.0) + ok_bracket_3_rate * (the maximum of ((the minimum of result.ok_band_midpoint and result.ok_limit_3) - result.ok_limit_2) and 0.0) + ok_bracket_4_rate * (the maximum of ((the minimum of result.ok_band_midpoint and result.ok_limit_4) - result.ok_limit_3) and 0.0) + ok_bracket_5_rate * (the maximum of ((the minimum of result.ok_band_midpoint and result.ok_limit_5) - result.ok_limit_4) and 0.0) + ok_bracket_6_rate * (the maximum of (result.ok_band_midpoint - result.ok_limit_5) and 0.0) + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: ok_bracket_1_rate result.ok_band_midpoint result.ok_limit_1 fmin fmul ok_bracket_2_rate result.ok_band_midpoint result.ok_limit_2 fmin result.ok_limit_1 f- 0.0 fmax fmul f+ ok_bracket_3_rate result.ok_band_midpoint result.ok_limit_3 fmin result.ok_limit_2 f- 0.0 fmax fmul f+ ok_bracket_4_rate result.ok_band_midpoint result.ok_limit_4 fmin result.ok_limit_3 f- 0.0 fmax fmul f+ ok_bracket_5_rate result.ok_band_midpoint result.ok_limit_5 fmin result.ok_limit_4 f- 0.0 fmax fmul f+ ok_bracket_6_rate result.ok_band_midpoint result.ok_limit_5 f- 0.0 fmax fmul f+ 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.ok_table_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ok_table_tax = the floor of (result.ok_high_base + ok_bracket_6_rate * (result.ok_taxable_income - ok_table_limit) + 0.5)
action_details.action_postfix: result.ok_high_base ok_bracket_6_rate result.ok_taxable_income ok_table_limit f- fmul f+ 0.5 f+ floor cvd /result.ok_table_tax xdef
